name: China Feihe Limited
summary: China Feihe Limited, an investment holding company, produces and sells dairy products, raw milk, and nutritional supplements in Mainland China, Canada, Indonesia, and the United States. It operates through two segments, Dairy Products and Nutritional Supplements Products; and Raw Milk. The company offers dairy products adult milk powders; liquid milk products; and rice powder supplement products, as well as health care products. It also retails vitamins, minerals, herbs, and other nutritional supplements.
